description: Lists Cognigy.AI connections (external service integrations like databases, APIs, etc.). Connections store credentials securely. Use this to find available connections for a project or organization.

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return (default: 25, max: 100)

projectId.description: Filter connections by project ID. Omit for all accessible connections.

resourceLevel.description: Scope: 'organisation' for global connections, 'project' for project-specific

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

name: list_connections
